observations.trace: SettlementLanguageProfile derives Default with three zero vernacular weights; its is_valid requires their sum to10000. Public initial_oral_languages nevertheless accepts the raw profile and passes the three weights to weighted_index, followed by expect. The pinned rand0.9.5 WeightedIndex source returns InsufficientNonZero for a zero sum, which the local wrapper maps to ZeroTotalWeight; therefore the source-level direct call with the default profile reaches the expect error. Geographic compiler inference creates a10000-total profile; database import requires is_valid and equality with geographic inference; inspected demo bootstrap profiles also total10000. Character creation and relocation read a settlement profile and call the initializer.

observations.trace: WrittenLanguageHours exposes public f32 fields and mutable access. With a hypothetical german=NaN, low=1000, other values zero, direct_fields_valid(5000) rejects the value, but effective(German) compares NaN <=0, which is false. Rust f32::max returns the non-NaN operand, so the NaN direct contribution becomes0 and Low contributes1000*0.35, about350 despite no finite direct German study. Selected simulation ingestion checks the finite bounds, and the book-training source consumes written effective values.

The PartyMember table has an auto-increment row primary key and nonunique btree character ID, while selected seeded attach logic avoids inserting when the character already declares the same party.
